summary: Barton Springs: operator page (headless; curl 403) and Campspot confirm 128 sites, 50/30/20 A + water, season Mar 15-Nov 15, 2-night minimum still on (Apr 2027). Lakefront KEPT: the operator's 11 lakefront sites (Campspot 9-21 odd, 33, 35-37) sit on open grass at the high-water edge. No operator change (camprrm.com/vista-rec redirect to Go Camp Tennessee). max_rig 40 -> 60.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT: operator 'All sites have a lake view, and 11 sites are lakefront, offering the availability to fish from your campsite!' Campspot names them: 'Waterfront 30/50 Amp RV Site' 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21, 33, 35, 36, 37, sold by the night (2-night minimum). The Campspot map puts them on the outer, northwest-facing edges of the two loops west of the entry road. On Esri imagery (winter drawdown, bare flats) the upper loop's outer gravel pads (~35.45555,-86.22226 to 35.45565,-86.22187) open straight onto mowed grass that ends at the flats ~10-20 m out; 3DEP gives the pads ~267.2 m and that edge ~266.8 m against Normandy's ~266.7 m summer pool - pads ~0.5 m above the summer waterline over a gentle bank, no tree line between. The west loop's outer pads (~35.45478,-86.22337) sit at 267.2-267.5 m beside flats at 266.4 m. Kayak test passes.

OPERATOR: Google's website link is camprrm.com; that path redirects to vista-rec.com (404) and the matching Cedar Point path redirects to gocamptennessee.com. Same company (Vista Recreation / RRM / Go Camp Tennessee, footer 'Tennessee Valley Hospitality LLC'); stored website links are current.

LONG STAY: the operator says it offers 'both short-term and long-term camping'; Campspot sells 77 of 128 sites by the night (~60%), so it passes the share test. Google 4.5 over 616 reviews; RV Life 4*/$$. Not a Good Sam Park; prices under $50 (site rate $40-47 stored from 2026-10-13; April 2027 list averages $50/$53 include the $10 per-stay surcharge and Campspot's 3% fee) - fees left as stored.

SITES: note-derived max_rig_ft 40 replaced with Campspot's 60 (island sites). Campspot tags every site Back-In while the operator says all but 49 are pull-through; pull_through kept on the operator's word.
PHONE 931-857-3777 and WEBSITE unchanged (gocamptennessee.com refuses plain curl with a Cloudflare 403 but renders in a browser).
